shared_qualifications: The source criterion is the dramatic anodic-current increase attributed to pitting; plotted values retain manual-reading precision, not the excess decimals in curated CSV targets.

Fig.11 on PDF p.5 explicitly identifies 0.137% material heated at 600 C for 1 h, and the surrounding heat-treatment discussion/Fig.13 also includes 0.137% material. This source label precision is retained instead of silently rewriting the registry or the CRA analysis.
